definitions.gloss: 99th birthday; celebration of one's ninety-ninth year
definitions.explanation: A traditional celebration of a person's 99th birthday. The name plays on the fact that removing the top stroke from {百|ひゃく} (hundred) leaves {白|はく} (white), i.e., "hundred minus one."

examples.japanese: {白寿|はくじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧。
{曽祖母|そうそぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{白寿|はくじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{白寿|はくじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧がしっかりしている。
examples.english: My grandmother, who has turned ninety-nine, is still mentally sharp.

notes:
{白寿|はくじゅ} celebrates a person's 99th birthday, the last of the widely celebrated Japanese longevity milestones (⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧). The name plays on ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundred): removing the top stroke of the character leaves {白|はく}, giving "hundred minus one"; the traditional celebratory color is white.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白寿|はくじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's ninety-ninth year
- {白寿|はくじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: a 99th-birthday celebration

TYPES:
Part of a sequence of longevity milestones: ⟦{古希|こき}→古希：29070_koki⟧ (70), ⟦{喜寿|きじゅ}→喜寿：29071_kiju⟧ (77), ⟦{傘寿|さんじゅ}→傘寿：30987_sanju⟧ (80), ⟦{米寿|べいじゅ}→米寿：30988_beiju⟧ (88), ⟦{卒寿|そつじゅ}→卒寿：30989_sotsuju⟧ (90), {白寿|はくじゅ} (99).
